# I amsterdam

> > Official city guide and tourism platform for Amsterdam, featuring attractions, events, transportation, and the I amsterdam City Card benefits.

I amsterdam is the official destination marketing organization for Amsterdam and the Amsterdam Metropolitan Area. The site provides comprehensive visitor information, business resources, cultural event listings, and practical guides for exploring the city, with special focus on the I amsterdam City Card and sustainable tourism initiatives like Amsterdam Impact.

## Key Topics

- I amsterdam City Card
- Amsterdam public transportation
- SAIL Amsterdam maritime festival
- Amsterdam neighborhoods
- Uitpas cultural discount program
- Amsterdam Impact social entrepreneurship
- RAI Amsterdam convention center
- Amsterdam Metropolitan Area
- Schiphol Airport
- Amsterdam shopping districts
- Amsterdam restaurant scene
- Amsterdam museums and culture
- Sustainable tourism
- Business events and conventions

## Visitor Essentials & City Cards

- [Bike rental with the I amsterdam City Card](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/tickets/i-amsterdam-city-card/bike-rental-with-the-i-amsterdam-city-card): Free 24-hour bike rental included with I amsterdam City Card
- [Get a discount on culture in Amsterdam with the Uitpas](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/tickets/uitpas/get-a-discount-on-culture-in-amsterdam-with-the-uitpas): Uitpas cultural discount subscription for Amsterdam museums and theaters
- [Trams in Amsterdam](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/travel-stay/getting-around/tram): How to travel by tram in Amsterdam with I amsterdam City Card info

## Major Events & Festivals

- [Best ways to experience SAIL 2025](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/whats-on/sail-amsterdam/best-ways-to-experience-sail-2025): Ultimate guide to SAIL Amsterdam 2025 maritime festival on IJ River
- [Unmissable events during SAIL Amsterdam 2025](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/whats-on/sail-amsterdam/unmissable-events-during-sail-amsterdam-2025): Event guide for SAIL Amsterdam 2025 maritime festival highlights
- [10 tips for observing Ramadan in Amsterdam](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/whats-on/festivals-and-events/10-tips-for-observing-ramadan-in-amsterdam): Ramadan observance guide with activities and iftar tips in Amsterdam

## Accommodation & Business Venues

- [Luxury hotels in Amsterdam](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/travel-stay/where-to-stay/luxury-hotels): Guide to luxury hotels in Amsterdam including Waldorf Astoria
- [Hotels with meeting spaces](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/conventions/accommodation/hotels-with-meeting-space): Business hotels with meeting spaces near Amsterdam Airport Schiphol

## Shopping & Markets

- [Shopping areas in Amsterdam](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/see-and-do/shopping-and-markets/shopping-areas-in-amsterdam): Shopping districts guide featuring 9 Straatjes and Paleiskwartier
- [Local Makers: Eberhardjes](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/see-and-do/shopping-and-markets/local-makers-eberhardjes): Profile of Eberhardjes Amsterdam Cookies makers Résalieke and Ineke

## Dining & Culinary Experiences

- [Best fish and seafood restaurants in Amsterdam](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/see-and-do/restaurant-and-bars/best-fish-and-seafood-restaurants-in-amsterdam): Guide to fish and seafood restaurants across Amsterdam neighborhoods
- [Best Sub-Saharan African restaurants in Amsterdam](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/see-and-do/restaurant-and-bars/best-sub-saharan-african-restaurants-in-amsterdam): Guide to Sub-Saharan African restaurants featuring Ethiopian cuisine
- [Best bubble tea in Amsterdam](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/see-and-do/restaurant-and-bars/best-bubble-tea-in-amsterdam): Guide to best bubble tea spots in Amsterdam featuring Taiwanese specialty
- [Rainy-day terraces](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/see-and-do/restaurant-and-bars/covered-terraces): Weather-proof covered terraces guide for outdoor dining in Amsterdam

## Amsterdam Impact & Social Initiatives

- [Looking Back on Scale Your Impact Event 2024](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/business/amsterdam-impact/looking-back-on-scale-your-impact-event-2024): Recap of Scale Your Impact 2024 social entrepreneurship event at Circa
- [Boost je Buurt 2025 – The Winners Are In!](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/business/amsterdam-impact/boost-je-buurt-2025-the-winners-are-in): Winners announcement for Boost je Buurt social impact initiative 2025
- [IASP 2024 World Pain Congress Brings Pain Experts from Around the Globe to Amsterdam: Free Activities for Residents](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/amsterdam-and-partners/iasp-2024-world-pain-congress-brings-pain-experts-from-around-the-globe-to-amsterdam-free-activities-for-residents): IASP World Pain Congress at RAI with free activities for Amsterdammers
- [Amsterdam residents receive free liver test at RAI Amsterdam](https://www.iamsterdam.com/en/amsterdam-and-partners/amsterdam-residents-receive-free-liver-test-at-rai-amsterdam): Free liver screening at EASL conference for Amsterdam residents at RAI
